title: Essential for a 10 year experience
text: All excellent. Very pleasant and complete explanations, with all the necessary details. The visit to such a beautiful place with so much history would have lost a lot without explanations like those of Ma Paz.
author: Alvaro C

title: Excellent
text: The tour flew away. You can tell M. Peace likes what he does. She's a nice, close girl. If I return to Seville I would like to match it again!
author: 188saran

title: Thank you very much Mari Paz for the great visit to Italica
text: I recommend it 100% our guide Mari Paz is a charm, explains everything thoroughly and without any hurry, of course the next visit to another place I choose to her without a doubt.
author: carmen_U7297NX

title: Wonderful visit from the Hand of a wonderful person.
text:
The professionalism, kindness and good doing that this woman puts into everything is an off-the-beaten-board thing. She greets you with a smile, shows you the place with detail and affection and, above all, makes you feel the same passion she feels for the places she teaches you. 

Ten. Everything. I definitely keep your contact for future visits.

Mari Paz, you are a true love. A pleasure to have been with you visiting a wonderful place with Italica.
author: Joselita16

title: Exploring Italica with Local Expert
text: She was the BEST with our kids! Almost 2 hours exploring Italica and sharing such wonderful insight. We were her first English tour (maybe ever according to her) and we loved every minute of it. So glad we chose to take this tour.
author: 813edwardd

title: Wonderful experience!!!
text: Our guide Mary Paz is extraordinary in her explanations, she shows her passion and knowledge in what she does, so the Tour of Italica was wonderful. Fully recommended to do the Tour with it!!!
author: nydiaacevedo

title: Guided tour of Italica and Monastery of San Isidoro del Campo
text:
On April 24th we carried out a cultural visit to Italica and the Monastery of San Isidoro del Campo, in Santiponce (Seville), with a group of 100 students and adults from a Center of Continuing Education. 
We have, for the guided tour, the company Margonvaztour. I would like to highlight and publicly thank Maripaz and his team of guides for their excellent work: Marta, Yohanna e Isabel.
